builds.target: Portable Linux AArch64 · native N64 static recompilation
builds.notes: GitHub-published Linux ARM64 artifact: BanjoRecompiled-v1.0.2-Linux-ARM64.tar.gz. Native N64 static recompilation of Banjo-Kazooie; requires a personally obtained North American 1.0 cartridge ROM. This community ARM64 Linux executable is not an emulator and does not include copyrighted original game data. Vulkan 1.2 graphics required; Steam Frame untested.
